name: Barrier of Light releases the threat redirect on every ally when its 15 second aura ends (#8885)
contract: Barrier of Light 805417 applies an APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID aura with a 15 second duration whose periodic trigger 807698 makes each affected player cast 807694 (SPELL_EFFECT_REDIRECT_THREAT, no aura) at the caster. The redirect lives only in the ally's threat manager, so it must be released when the ally's Barrier of Light application ends; otherwise the ally keeps feeding threat to the caster after the aura has gone.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Party the monk and the ally
Clear the global cooldown of the learn
The ally redirects threat to the monk
Let the 15 second aura run out
The ally no longer redirects threat
The monk no longer redirects threat
